parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic. It is circular and slightly convex to allow easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or lotion through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, compressing the internal spring and forcing liquid through the spout.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section includes the nozzle and upper housing of the pump, made of plastic. It connects the pressing lid to the internal pump tube.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the outside through the nozzle when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but allows internal fluid flow when the lid is pressed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, cylindrical in shape and made of transparent or semi-transparent PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid.
